extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed bounded mechanism adjudication. The paper supports phenotypic MIC activity plus computational docking/MD context for DNA gyrase and lanosterol 14-alpha demethylase; it does not provide a direct biochemical inhibition, membrane permeabilization, or target-validation assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Compounds 6a-6j have source-located antimicrobial phenotype evidence from MIC testing against four bacterial and two fungal strains.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC testing establishes antimicrobial phenotype, not a molecular mechanism of action.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DNA gyrase involvement is supported only as computational docking/MD context, with Table 2 docking scores and figures for selected indole derivatives.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: docking/MD models for selected derivatives, especially compound 6c
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct DNA gyrase enzymatic inhibition assay is reported in local XML/PDF/supplement materials.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lanosterol 14-alpha demethylase involvement is supported only as computational docking/MD context, with Table 3 docking scores and figures for selected indole derivatives.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: docking/MD models for selected derivatives, especially compound 6c
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct CYP51/lanosterol demethylase enzymatic inhibition assay is reported in local XML/PDF/supplement materials.
